status: frozen post hoc control on 12 previously scored fanout development cells; not confirmation
hub_actions: Five pair batches: first three target shared motif 0 with level pairs (-2,-2), (-2,2), (2,2); last two target distinct downstream motifs with levels (2,2), (-2,-2).
hub_random_order: First two indices of a permutation of motifs 1..k-1 from numpy.default_rng(system_seed + 991337). No acquired data or true coefficients are used.
rng_coupling: All hub arms share the risk arm's initial acquisition and padding RNG seeds; the actual streams may diverge because risk scores candidate simulations and actions can differ.
analysis: Report each seed and k, mean MSE, and paired win counts of risk_pair versus each hub control. Also report action motifs, levels, exact cost, and masked labels. Do not select the better hub control separately per system.
decision: If either static hub control matches risk across systems, do not claim adaptive posterior design on fanout. Even if risk remains better, test a graph family without a single shared parent before confirmation.
